source.title: Call for Applicants - WRC Members (December 2024)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) is looking for new members! Interested community members of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Applications are open to everyone; it is not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

<!-- break -->

### What does the WRC do?

The official rights and duties of the WRC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2024.9](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.9%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf). The WRC is a large team which has a variety of responsibilities that members are needed to fulfill, including resolving incidents that occur at competitions, updating the WCA Regulations, and developing regulations-related resources for WCA Delegates and the WCA Community.

New WRC members will begin by gaining experience discussing incidents that are reported at competitions, and soon after will either continue to do so or transfer to other work, depending on both interest level and team resources. 

### Where do you fit in?

WRC Members are split into various subteams, each focusing on various tasks. The positions the WRC is recruiting for are as follows:

_Reports:_ Members discuss, make decisions, and give feedback to WCA Delegates on incidents that happen at competitions. This team is further split into two areas: some members of this team focus on resolving the incidents and communicating with WCA Staff, while others focus on the documentation of these incidents. 

_Regulations:_ Members are in charge of overseeing updates of the WCA Regulations as per [WCA Motion 14.2022.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/14.2022.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Regulations.pdf). This involves gathering proposals, developing and discussing wordings, and interacting with feedback from the WCA Staff and Community. Members may additionally work on other Regulations related items, most notably keeping the [translations page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/) up to date.

### Requirements

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

* At least 16 years of age as of January 1st, 2025
* Availability throughout the week – expected time commitment of ~5 hours per week
* Ability to communicate comfortably in written English
* Familiarity with the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, though it is not necessary nor expected that applicants have a perfect working knowledge
* Familiarity with the competition environment
* Ability to communicate constructively and respectfully, even when you disagree
* (Optional) Experience with Github – useful for Regulations subteam 

### How to Apply

Candidacy documents must include:

* A brief personal introduction
* Summary of activities done for the WCA and the cubing community
* Overview of skills relevant to the role
* Motivation for joining the WRC
* Which position you are most interested in

Candidacy documents must be in **PDF format.** The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now **until December 29th, 2024, 23:59 UTC privately to Carter Kucala (ckucala@worldcubeassociation.org).**

You can expect a reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WRC Leader and up to two other members.

If you have any questions about WRC work or the application cycle, you may email Carter Kucala (ckucala@worldcubeassociation.org) or João Vinícius (jvinicius@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WRC and the WCA!

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会招募成员（2024 年 12 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会（WRC）正在招募新成员！欢迎不同背景的社区成员申请。所有人均可报名，无需已在 WCA 担任职务。

<!-- break -->

### WRC 负责什么？

WRC 的正式权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2024.9](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.9%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf)。WRC 团队规模较大，需要成员分担多项工作，包括处理比赛中发生的事件、更新 WCA 竞赛规则，以及为 WCA 代表和社区编写规则相关资料。

新成员会先参与讨论比赛上报的事件，积累经验。随后，根据个人兴趣和团队人手安排，可以继续处理事件，也可以转向其他工作。

### 有哪些岗位？

WRC 成员分属不同小组，各有工作重点。本次招募的岗位如下：

_报告小组：_ 讨论和裁定比赛中发生的事件，并向 WCA 代表反馈意见。组内又分两类工作：一部分成员侧重处理事件、与 WCA 工作人员沟通，另一部分侧重记录整理这些事件。

_规则小组：_ 根据 [WCA 议案 14.2022.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/14.2022.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Regulations.pdf)负责 WCA 竞赛规则的更新，包括收集提案、起草和讨论条文，以及回应 WCA 工作人员和社区的反馈。成员也可能参与其他规则相关工作，尤其是维护[规则翻译页面](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/)。

### 申请条件

我们希望申请人具备：

* 截至 2025 年 1 月 1 日年满 16 岁。
* 一周中能够持续参与，预计每周投入约 5 小时。
* 能够熟练使用书面英语沟通。
* 熟悉 WCA 竞赛规则与指南，但不要求也不期待申请人对所有条文都完全熟练掌握。
* 熟悉比赛环境。
* 即使意见不同，也能尊重他人、建设性地沟通。
* （非必需）GitHub 使用经验，对规则小组的工作有帮助。

### 如何申请

申请材料须包含：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 为 WCA 和魔方社区所做工作的概述。
* 与岗位有关的技能。
* 加入 WRC 的动机。
* 你最感兴趣的岗位。

申请材料须为 **PDF 格式**。申请从即日起开放，**请于 2024 年 12 月 29 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下发送给 Carter Kucala（ckucala@worldcubeassociation.org）**。

我们会回复确认材料是否完整；你也可能收到面试邀请，面试人员为 WRC 负责人及最多两名其他成员。

如对 WRC 工作或本次招募有疑问，可联系 Carter Kucala（ckucala@worldcubeassociation.org）或 João Vinícius（jvinicius@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢你愿意协助 WRC 和 WCA！
